subject: Physical Education

internalBreakdown.component: Proficiency in games and sports (one IOA recognised sport)
Viva voce (health, games and sports, yoga)

textbooks: Physical Education, Class XI (as per CBSE curriculum)
notes: Unit marks include the concept-based alternative questions (tactile diagrams, data interpretation, case studies) set for visually impaired candidates.
Record file practicals: fitness test administration; procedure, benefits and contraindications of two asanas; one IOA recognised sport.

units.name: Changing Trends and Careers in Physical Education

chapters.name: Changing Trends and Careers in Physical Education
topics: Concept, aims and objectives of physical education
Development of physical education in India after independence
Changing trends in sports: playing surfaces, wearable gear, equipment, technology
Career options in physical education
Khelo India and Fit India programmes

chapters.name: Olympism Value Education
topics: Olympism: concept and Olympic values (excellence, friendship, respect)
Olympic value education: joy of effort, fair play, respect for others, pursuit of excellence, balance of body, will and mind
Ancient and modern Olympics
Olympic symbols, motto, flag, oath and anthem
Olympic movement structure: IOC, NOC, IFs, other members

chapters.name: Yoga
topics: Meaning and importance of yoga
Introduction to Ashtanga yoga
Yogic kriyas (shat karma)
Pranayama and its types
Active lifestyle and stress management through yoga

units.name: Physical Education and Sports for Children with Special Needs

chapters.name: Physical Education and Sports for Children with Special Needs
topics: Concept of disability and disorder
Types, causes and nature of disability (intellectual, physical)
Disability etiquette
Aims and objectives of adaptive physical education
Role of professionals: counsellor, occupational therapist, physiotherapist, PE teacher, speech therapist, special educator

chapters.name: Physical Fitness, Wellness and Lifestyle
topics: Meaning and importance of wellness, health and physical fitness
Components and dimensions of wellness, health and fitness
Traditional sports and regional games for promoting wellness
Leadership through physical activity and sports
Introduction to first aid: PRICE

chapters.name: Test, Measurement and Evaluation
topics: Test, measurement and evaluation: definitions and importance in sports
BMI, waist-hip ratio, skinfold measurement (3-site)
Somatotypes: endomorphy, mesomorphy, ectomorphy
Measurement of health related fitness

units.name: Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology in Sports

chapters.name: Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology in Sports
topics: Importance of anatomy and physiology in exercise and sports
Skeletal system: functions, classification of bones, types of joints
Properties and functions of muscles
Structure and functions of the circulatory system and heart
Structure and functions of the respiratory system

units.name: Fundamentals of Kinesiology and Biomechanics in Sports

chapters.name: Fundamentals of Kinesiology and Biomechanics in Sports
topics: Importance of kinesiology and biomechanics in sports
Principles of biomechanics
Kinetics and kinematics in sports
Body movements: flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, rotation, circumduction, supination, pronation
Axes and planes and their application in body movements

chapters.name: Psychology and Sports
topics: Importance of psychology in physical education and sports
Growth and development at different stages
Adolescent problems and their management
Team cohesion and sports
Psychological attributes: attention, resilience, mental toughness

chapters.name: Training and Doping in Sports
topics: Concept and principles of sports training
Training load: overload, adaptation and recovery
Warming up and limbering down: types, methods, importance
Skill, technique, tactics and strategy
Concept of doping and its disadvantages
